name: Phong Splatting
definition: A surface splatting rendering technique that uses per-pixel lighting with linear normal fields, elliptical splat shapes, and antialiasing via Gaussian filtering and blending to achieve superior visual quality on modern GPUs.
summary: Phong Splatting is a surface splatting technique that assigns a linearly varying normal field to each elliptical splat, enabling per-pixel Phong shading without surface connectivity.
